Full Release + Survival Mode
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27206099/b6adc0c4811a9b40259dce780ccba9a1693465c8.png[/img]

The long-awaited moment of the Full Release has finally arrived. We would like to thank all the Early Access participants whose feedback has been incredibly useful for us. During the past month, when the game was being reworked, we balanced it several times, and now both middle and high level players can enjoy it.

For the occasion of the game release we have also prepared a small complement – «Survival Mode». Unlike in the main game, here you don’t have to dodge the adversary’s attacks since now you play against zombies. Your mission is to protect defensive posts. Zombies can be stricken only when shot precisely in head, with each shoot being able to kill only one zombie. The mini-game will help the players who have already completed the game during the Early Access to start it once again and test their playing skills.

The sequel of the game (DED 2) is going to be released soon.

Stay tuned!

[b]Linux/Steam OS - April 2017[/b]

notes.content:
If you've been waiting for enough updates to try the game - the time has come! Now campaign is not only fully playable, but also intro and tooltips got added. 

All that's left to implement for release is additional blood, female enemies and some graphic options.

notes.title: [0.5.5] Update
notes.content:
Now you can customize keyboard controls. Except you can't change actions of default keys, only add additional ones. Both sets would work at the same time and you don't have to bind every additional action.

Display area got reworked, so now game field is more zoomed-in by default on most screen resolutions(1366x768, 1280x1024, etc.).

You can also control zoom on controller using LB и RT buttons.

notes.title: «Double-barreled shotgun» challenge.
notes.content:
Second marathon awaits our heroic DED. Now he got a hold of his favorite old trusty double-barreled shotgun. Less distance and ammo but look at that damage!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/571350/announcements/detail/677065258246890598]Prizes are the same for most hardcore players - free keys for upcoming DLC.[/url]

But there's a slight pleasant change in the rules - now you can be eligible to win even if someone else has reached that wave before you, because now everyone has unique UserID and therefore verification code.

So for example, if max wave reached is 42, then three players to reach it first win.

Good luck and git gud!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/571350/discussions/0/135507548120630259/]«Double-barreled Shotgun» challenge. Kill count.[/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/571350/discussions/0/135507548120635986/]«Double-barreled Shotgun» challenge. Wave records.[/url]

[b]Kill count:[/b] Lord - 1548

[b]Wave records:[/b]

[/list]
[h1]Congratulations![/h1]

notes.title: «Dirty Harry» challenge.
notes.content:
DED launches with a 24-hour marathon «Dirty Harry». You're holding a legendary S&W Model 29, now go and kill 'em all! 

3 most skilled players would get Steam key for DLC «DED:Versus» for free.

You need to survive as many enemy waves as possible. As soon as you reach a wave that nobody yet have - post [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/571350/discussions/0/135507403158589382/]here[/url] a message with reached wave and the code game gives you. You can also check your best wave and code under «Dirty Harry» in menu.  3 players who reach 3 highest waves earlier than the rest would win.

[b]Example:[/b]
[list]
[*]Alan posted at 10:00 that he reached wave 4
[*]Ben – wave 5 at 10:00
[*]Chris – wave 5 at 10:30
[*]Dennis – wave 8 at 9:45
[/list]
[b]Winners:[/b] Alan, Ben, Dennis.

One more key would also be awarded to the most persistent player with the most kills accumulated until the end of the marathon. Post your records [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/571350/discussions/0/135507403158626211/]here[/url].

Discussion threads would be closed to determine winners one hour after the game update and the launch of next marathon «Double-barreled Shotgun».

Any kind of deception might incur permanent bans!

[h1]Winners:[/h1] 
[b]Kill count:[/b] ♚Protosonic♚ - 2345

[b]Wave records:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Nemurenai - 18
[*]Memoric - 8
[*]Lord - 6
[/list]
[h1]Congratulations![/h1]

notes.title: The road to hell is paved with good intentions
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27206099/f5ddfa9118e2698e05796c570904c015836bc02e.png[/img]

A week before planned release we've decided that we have enough time to polish the game more. Initially there were 10-15 fighters with different looks in one gang. But we deemed that not enough, therefore started implementing appearance generator which produces 100-150 different look combinations. But, as it sometimes happens, plans overwhelmed reality, and we've been working on that feature for two weeks already, but it's worth it.

[b]Release: January 13, 2017[/b]

[b]UPD: January 16, 2017[/b]

[b]UPD2: January 23, 2017[/b]
